nodes.label: Vss support-volume error
nodes.rationale: Support-volume estimates were 40-60% below 3DWOX and sometimes negative, making Vss the first calibration gap.

nodes.label: Pointwise volume integration
nodes.rationale: Summing point coordinates before integration removed negative support-volume values.

nodes.label: 3DWOX slicer validation
nodes.rationale: 3DWOX filament and support estimates serve as the external reference for tomography calibration.

nodes.label: Slot and matchPair logic
nodes.rationale: Alternating alpha/beta slot events and excessive deletion were corrected to stabilize NV construction.

nodes.label: YPR rotation-order bug
nodes.rationale: A wrong rotation order in drawOptimals produced a false optimal orientation.

nodes.label: NVb minus NVa plot
nodes.rationale: Plot2DTomo was changed to display NVb-NVa, aligning visualization with the signed NV definition.

nodes.label: PixelMatching WFunc calibration
nodes.rationale: The WFunc was recalibrated using the PixelMatching implementation and a high-resolution sphere.

nodes.label: Sphere rotation invariance
nodes.rationale: A sphere yielded identical values across 90-degree YPR rotations, providing a symmetry sanity check.

nodes.label: Partial pixelizeMesh parallelization
nodes.rationale: Pixelization was identified as slow enough to justify partial parallelization.

nodes.label: PNP pipeline merge
nodes.rationale: PNP functions were merged into the main pixelized tomography implementation.

nodes.label: Direction-dependent slot pairing
nodes.rationale: Omitting slot pairing improved speed but corrupted diagonal and optimal-orientation results.

nodes.label: Three-axis PNP composition
nodes.rationale: Combining PNP representations generated in three directions reduced missing side pixels and orientation error.

nodes.label: removeZNearPxls bottleneck
nodes.rationale: removeZNearPxls after slot conversion remained a major performance cost.

nodes.label: Box-cutting calibration
nodes.rationale: Simple cut and uncut cubes isolate model-volume errors from support-structure errors.

nodes.label: Fcore and Fclad validation
nodes.rationale: Cube tests showed the internal core and cladding fill calculations were working within roughly 5-10%.

nodes.label: One-millimeter wall calibration
nodes.rationale: A 1.0 mm wall thickness minimized the discrepancy with 3DWOX.

nodes.label: Mss mass discrepancy
nodes.rationale: Theoretical support volume was accurate but slicer support mass differed strongly and non-uniformly.

nodes.label: Support-everywhere slicer setting
nodes.rationale: Using build-plate-only support omitted non-bed beta triangles; support everywhere was needed for comparable validation.

nodes.label: Height-dependent support correction
nodes.rationale: Condenser spacing tests suggested support error depended on pixel height rather than a single scalar factor.

nodes.label: Css 1.26 calibration factor
nodes.rationale: Regression slopes at three support fill ratios averaged to a multiplicative Css factor of 1.26.

nodes.label: NV threshold-angle trend failure
nodes.rationale: Bunny tests reversed the expected Vss trend as the critical angle increased, indicating an NV formulation problem.

nodes.label: Bunny and manikin validation
nodes.rationale: Stanford Bunny and human manikin orientations compared theoretical, slicer, printing, Mathematica, and Python results.

nodes.label: Python speed advantage
nodes.rationale: The tabulated experiments showed the Python implementation was substantially faster than Mathematica.

nodes.label: Spherical-cap exact Vss

nodes.rationale: Sphere30 matched the analytic spherical-cap support volume when Css was one.

nodes.label: sin(theta_c)^5 linearity
nodes.source_file: D:\_Research_Vault\연구노트\중견1차년도(2022)\graph-corpus\008 2022-03-06 Tomography 고차화 -Mss 오차 원인 분석 계속.md
nodes.rationale: The support response appeared linear against the fifth power of sine of the critical angle.

nodes.label: Critical-angle warp
nodes.source_file: D:\_Research_Vault\연구노트\중견1차년도(2022)\graph-corpus\008 2022-03-06 Tomography 고차화 -Mss 오차 원인 분석 계속.md
nodes.rationale: The note proposes warping nominal critical angles to reproduce slicer behavior near 15 and 75 degrees.

nodes.label: cos(theta)^5 support formula
nodes.rationale: Mathematica factorization exposed a fifth-power cosine structure in the spherical-cap expression.

nodes.label: Polynomial Wsum correction
nodes.rationale: A polynomial fit to the slicer/predicted ratio replaced the global Css scalar.

nodes.label: Divide-by-zero-safe correction
nodes.rationale: The correction ratio required explicit handling when predicted support approached zero.

nodes.label: GetWeightedZSum
nodes.rationale: Weighted support-height summation is the implementation point for the angular correction function.

nodes.label: Normal-augmented shadow points
nodes.rationale: Point records were extended with normal components so WFunc could depend on local surface orientation.

nodes.label: Beta-normal merge rule
nodes.rationale: Merged pixels retain the beta-facing normal with the smallest z component.

nodes.label: Beta-pixel duplicate removal
nodes.rationale: Failure to deduplicate plistBeta distorted Vb and was fixed using xy grouping and maximum z.

nodes.label: Weighted total-mass improvement
nodes.rationale: GetWeightZSum improved total Mo+Mss trends even while support-only orientation trends remained weak.

nodes.label: Unprincipled Css equals 2
nodes.rationale: Css=2 improved default-condition fits but lacked physical justification and broke previously calibrated cases.

nodes.label: Localized duplicate-point removal
nodes.rationale: Applying near-point erasure only within GatherByFirstTwo groups accelerated duplicate removal about tenfold.

nodes.label: Integer voxelization
nodes.rationale: Integer xyz pixels simplified equality and merging while normals remained separate metadata.

nodes.label: Pixelwise Vo and Vss correction
nodes.rationale: Earlier aggregate summation rather than pixelwise processing explained incorrect Vo and Vss figures.

nodes.label: Integer-z discretization
nodes.rationale: Rounding elevated z coordinates during voxelization reduced errors below roughly 11%.

nodes.label: Python 4D visualization
nodes.rationale: The corrected Python implementation was positioned to reproduce the 4D graph workflow.

nodes.label: tomoNV Python class
nodes.rationale: The 3D sphere and 4D box computations were consolidated into a reusable Python class.

nodes.label: Ray-parallel pixelization
nodes.rationale: Parallelizing whole mesh pixelization tasks yielded large multi-orientation speedups.

nodes.label: Ray startup overhead
nodes.rationale: An approximately eight-second ray.init cost makes parallelization unattractive for a single small file.

nodes.label: Open3D serialization constraint
nodes.rationale: Ray workers could not directly access Open3D objects, so numpy vertices and triangles were passed instead.

nodes.label: Ray-parallel WeightedSum
nodes.rationale: WeightedSum was integrated into the parallel tomoNV class.

nodes.label: uniqueIntList xyz deduplication
nodes.rationale: Deduplicating only integer xyz coordinates preserves the associated nz normal value.

nodes.label: Four-component pixel format
nodes.rationale: Pixels were reduced to x,y,z,nz, retaining just the normal component needed for angular weighting.

nodes.label: Piecewise Wsum regression
nodes.rationale: Three angular regression intervals avoided the oscillation of a global fifth-order interpolation.

nodes.label: High-order interpolation fluctuation
nodes.rationale: Fifth-order and cosine-based interpolation oscillated, motivating piecewise regression.

nodes.label: Mss 0.1-percent error
nodes.rationale: The final piecewise correction reportedly reduced Mss error to about 0.1%.

nodes.label: tomoNV journal shortlist
nodes.rationale: The note compares impact, review speed, acceptance rate, and scope across manufacturing journals.

nodes.label: Additive Manufacturing journal
nodes.rationale: It was the highest-impact venue in the shortlist.

nodes.label: International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology
nodes.rationale: IJAMT was listed as a scope-compatible manufacturing venue and later selected for resubmission.

nodes.label: IJAMT resubmission
nodes.rationale: A publisher recommendation prompted transfer of the tomoNV paper to IJAMT.

nodes.label: GPGPU workstation plan
nodes.rationale: A Ryzen 7950X and dual RTX-class workstation was evaluated for high-performance GPGPU research.

nodes.label: A1 textile-society poster
nodes.rationale: The research was prepared for dissemination as an A1 conference poster.

nodes.label: Dual RTX 4090 system
nodes.rationale: The workstation plan matured to an AMD 7000-series system with two RTX 4090 GPUs.

nodes.label: Equipment-budget reallocation
nodes.rationale: Personnel funds were considered for transfer to equipment to fund the planned system.

nodes.label: 3D-printer procurement placeholder
nodes.rationale: The dated page marks planned 3D-printer procurement even though its body is empty.

nodes.label: Laboratory equipment rack
nodes.rationale: A five-tier rack was specified to house new laboratory equipment.

nodes.label: Display and printer cables
nodes.rationale: DP 1.4 and USB printer cables were specified in multiple lengths for the equipment setup.
